title: Postoperative Respiratory and Activity Monitoring
summary: This study plans to learn more about specific breathing and activity recommendations for patients after surgery. Participants will be monitored after abdominal surgery to identify what activities help them breathe better and reduce complications after surgery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must be 18 or older
* Must be undergoing abdominal surgery
* Must be high-risk for PPCs (ARISCAT score equal to or greater than 26)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anyone under 18
* Anyone not undergoing abdominal surgery
* Anyone that is not high-risk for PPCs (ARISCAT score less than 26)
